import java.util.*;

public class E {
    static final int SIZE = (1 << 21) + 1;
    static final int p = 1000000007;
    static long inf;
    static int n;
    static int[][] a = new int[11][11];
    static int[][] f = new int[11][131];
    static int[] is = new int[131];
    static long i100;
    static Map<LLL, Integer>[] st = new HashMap[8];
    static LLL mx = new LLL();
    static LLL stt = new LLL();

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            st[i] = new HashMap<>();
        }
        inf = 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3fL;
    }

    static class LLL {
        long a, b;

        void set(int x) {
            if (x < 64) a |= 1L << x;
            else b |= 1L << (x - 64);
        }

        void reset() {
            a = 0;
            b = 0;
        }

        LLL orEquals(LLL ano) {
            this.a |= ano.a;
            this.b |= ano.b;
            return this;
        }

        boolean equals(LLL ano) {
            return b == ano.b && a == ano.a;
        }

        boolean get(int ano) {
            if (ano < 64) return (a & (1L << ano)) != 0;
            else return (b & (1L << (ano - 64))) != 0;
        }
    }

    static boolean lessThan(LLL a, LLL b) {
        return a.b < b.b || (a.b == b.b && a.a < b.a);
    }

    static boolean greaterThan(LLL a, LLL b) {
        return a.b > b.b || (a.b == b.b && a.a > b.a);
    }

    static long fpm(long a, int b) {
        long c = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) c = c * a % p;
            a = a * a % p;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return c;
    }

    static int dfs(int x, LLL w) {
        if (x == n) return w.equals(mx) ? 1 : 0;
        if (st[x].containsKey(w)) return st[x].get(w);
        int ans = 0;
        LLL[] s = new LLL[n];
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) s[j] = new LLL();
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) s[j].reset();

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            if (w.get(i)) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if ((i & (1 << j)) == 0) {
                        s[j].set(i | (1 << j));
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            LLL ng = new LLL();
            ng.a = w.a;
            ng.b = w.b;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if ((i & (1 << j)) != 0) {
                    ng.orEquals(s[j]);
                }
            }
            long temp = (long) f[x][i] * dfs(x + 1, ng) % p;
            ans = (ans + (int) temp) % p;
        }
        st[x].put(w, ans);
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer stz = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(stz.nextToken());

                    }

        System.out.println(dfs(0, stt));
